thread:
Anya P: heads-up — nightly eval (pset v76) shows a sharp drop vs v75 on the 'golden_masked_accuracy' metric: 0.912 -> 0.836 (8.4% absolute). Started at 03:00 UTC runs. PR that touched the pset: https://git.repo/r/pset/PR-4482 :eyes:

eval-bot: nightly-eval/pset_v76 | model=redwood-v2 | run_id=nv-2026-03-20-03:00
  metrics: golden_masked_accuracy=0.836 (-8.4%), rerank_precision@1=0.78 (-4.9%)
  failures: 312/4000 failing cases, sample diffs attached (see thread)

Marta K: thanks, looking. quick Q — was this a prompt wording tweak or example set change in PR-4482?

Kevin H: PR diff was mostly rephrasing + removed 2 disambiguation exemplars for the 'person_mask' case. snippet:```diff
- Example: "Mask the person's name: [MASK] said..."
+ Example: "Fill the masked token in the sentence."
```

Sam R: grabbing sample failures now. quick sample where v75 gives `"[REDACTED_NAME] called the manager"` and v76 yields generic "The person called the manager" — looks like we lost proper masked-name generation on some templates.

Li Chen: ran a small quick-check with quantized runtime (int8) vs fp16 for redwood-v2 on same commit — quantization delta is tiny (<0.5%); doesn't explain 8% drop.

Marta K: good call. if quantization isn't it then it's likely prompt phrasing change made the prompt less explicit about named-entity filling. Can we diff the canonical examples used by eval harness?

Anya P: Kevin, can you paste the exact examples removed? I want to verify overlap with pset examples.

Kevin H: pasted:```
- "Person A: [MASK] walked in."
- "Person B: [MASK] said hello."
```
They were short, targeted to encourage name tokens. I removed them because they looked redundant with the new phrasing.

Sam R: hypothesis: the removed exemplars acted as strong priors on generation surface forms (prefix bias). Without them the model backs off to generic noun phrases. That will hit golden_masked_accuracy particularly.

ops-bot: CI note — PR-4482 merged to main at 2026-03-19T22:58:12Z. Autodeploy: enabled. Rollout ID: ro-77c4.

Marta K: can we run a focused ablation? If we reintroduce the 2 short exemplars into a quick canary and run the same nightly eval, does the metric recover?

Anya P: yes — plan: (1) create quick revert-variant branch that inserts the 2 exemplars back into pset; (2) run /run-eval pset_v76 --model redwood-v2 --subset=golden_masked --priority=high; (3) if metric recovers -> we'll rebaseline PR-4482 or patch with exemplar rewording.

Kevin H: making branch now: https://git.repo/r/pset/branch/add-back-examples-4482 (will push in 5m).

ci-bot: triggered job eval-job-9921 for branch add-back-examples-4482. ETA ~ 18m.

Li Chen: also queued a model-level canary: redwood-v2@canary to double-check no-serving-layer changes. queued run id=can-2026-03-20-03-18.

Sam R: sample diffs (excerpt):```
CASE 1209
PROMPT: "Fill in the masked token: [MASK] went to the store."
v75: "John went to the store."
v76: "The person went to the store."
```

Marta K: if the ablation recovers, I want signoff from ML owners to either (A) re-add concise exemplars back into canonical pset with a short rationale, or (B) rebaseline nightly gold set to reflect new expected behavior. I'd prefer (A) for backward compat with downstream tasks.

Anya P: agreed — rebaseline only if we confirm the change is intended. For now hold rollouts that depend on pset v76 — tagging product and infra. @Kevin H assign follow-up PR with justification.

Kevin H: assigned PR-4490 with the re-add patch and explanation. triage checklist added to PR description.

eval-bot: partial results back for eval-job-9921 | branch=add-back-examples-4482
  golden_masked_accuracy=0.905 (recovery from 0.836 -> +6.9%)
  rerank_precision@1=0.776 (+0.5%)
  failing_cases=84/4000

Marta K: that's promising. not full v75 baseline (0.912) but way closer. maybe we need a slightly different exemplar phrasing.

Anya P: next steps: Kevin iterate exemplar wording in PR-4490 (we'll test 2 variants), Li will run quant check across canary shapes, Marta will prepare rebaseline vs revert recommendation for Monday. Sam please collect top 50 failing case IDs and add to the eval issue.

Sam R: on it. adding cases to https://tickets/incidents/EV-1287 and will upload csv.

ops-bot: blocking autodeploy hooks for downstream orgs that depend on pset v76 until EV-1287 triage is closed.

Kevin H: pushing variant A and B now. PR updated.

Anya P: thanks everyone. please react with :thumbsup: when you've completed your assigned item so I can close the loop in the incident doc.

Marta K: thumbs up when case list uploaded.

Sam R: :thumbsup: uploaded case list and sample golden diffs.

Li Chen: :thumbsup: quant runs green.

Kevin H: :thumbsup: variants pushed.

Anya P: I'll draft a short changelog entry and notify product that we held the rollout pending final decision. If PR-4490 recovers metric fully we'll merge; otherwise we'll proceed to formal rebaseline.

eval-bot: final note — nightly-eval alert will remain muted until EV-1287 cleared to avoid noise.

Anya P: closing for now, will reopen if further regressions pop up. :eyes:
